The ISNPS conference series is the society's central gathering point: a biennial meeting built around plenary talks, invited sessions, contributed talks, posters, and broad exchange across nonparametric statistics.

## Next meeting

::: {.conference-spotlight}
### 7th ISNPS Conference

**Thessaloniki, Greece**  
**22-26 June 2026**

The official conference site contains the most current submission, registration, local-information, and schedule updates.

[Visit the conference website](https://easyconferences.eu/isnps2026/){.button .button-primary}
:::
